surface: plate_core.git_hooks + gh plate hooks + scripts/plate/pre-push-hook.sh + docs/bootstrap/pre-push-hook.md + AGENTS.md PLATES-CORE block
summary: Ship a configurable pre-push hook template and `gh plate hooks install` to run format, lint, and typecheck on changed files only; exits cleanly when no commands are configured (#1281).
migration_impact: Adopters opt in: set hooks.pre_push commands in .plate and run `gh plate hooks install`. Bootstrap surfaces the optional step. No CI or branch-protection changes.
migration_guidance: Import payload or bootstrap to receive scripts/plate/pre-push-hook.sh and docs/bootstrap/pre-push-hook.md.
Add hooks.pre_push format/lint/typecheck command templates to .plate (use {files} for changed paths).
Run `gh plate hooks install` from the repo root on each developer machine.
agent_notes: Prefer installed hooks over AGENTS.md prose for must-always-run local checks. Idea credit: Owen Gretzinger X post on Boardy CI (Oct 2026); PLATE wording and tooling are original.
